articles.title: Sainsbury's agrees £120m deal to sell Argos
articles.summary: Sainsbury's has revealed it is selling Argos under a "business as usual" deal that will allow the company to concentrate on its core grocery business. Sainsbury's said it expected cash proceeds of at least £120m from the agreement with Swift Partners, whose shareholders include Richard Pennycook - a former chief executive of the Co-op Group. Sainsbury's emphasised that the transfer of ownership would not result in any visible changes, such as job losses or the loss of customer loyalty benefits.
